scope: Custom-domain production cutover and legacy-domain migration; preserves v313 Nara, v312 Theme Studio/members, v311 onboarding, v310 Posts/Pages and the existing Studio sidebar authority.
notes: Production domain configuration now selects the Full Zone code path already implemented by the Worker.
Refreshing an older legacy domain migrates it into a real Full Zone instead of trying a removed legacy custom-hostname identifier.
A legacy custom_domain value is cleared during migration and is written back only after Cloudflare reports the zone active and the Worker domain has a certificate.
Existing free *.ngeblogging.com addresses are not removed by this migration.
No custom domain is labeled active merely because a database row says active; Full Zone verification remains authoritative.
